propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with one bounded pydantic-ai Agent operation that composes the S1 output-policy adapter while preserving full history and request budget.

Implement wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor that includes failed ModelResponse on retry wire only when input_tokens + output_tokens + effective_max_tokens fits model context window; omit response wholly (never partially) when it does not fit or token count is unknown.
Raise ContextWindowExceededError without content shortening when authoritative input alone overflows the context window.

Guard attachment is per output mode: on prompted branch use concision-aware guard that raises ModelRetry with concision instruction on length/max_tokens finish reason; on NativeOutput branch keep pai_output.guard_capability() unchanged and treat truncation as terminal.

Compute combined request_limit = ceil(eff_max_iter/2) + output_retry_allowance once with no per-attempt reset; seed both retries={"output": N} and request_limit addend from single value so request budget cannot exhaust before output-retry counter.
NativeOutput branch selection via output_mode, shared bounded operation with shared counter, and bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback to prompted path remain unchanged; only manual loop is replaced.
